events.title: 노팅엄 포리스트 are relegated from the Premier League after a 2–0 defeat to 셰필드 유나이티드 at the City Ground . Oldham, who also have 40 points but have played fewer games, still have a mathematical chance of survival but need at least six points from their final three games to avoid relegation. 노리치 시티 beat 리버풀 1–0 at Carrow Road to move closer to securing third place – which will mean a place in the UEFA Cup if 아스널 win the FA Cup final later this month.
맨체스터 유나이티드 are confirmed as league champions of England for the first time in 26 years after 애스턴 빌라 lose 1–0 at home to 올덤 애슬레틱, which is a big boost for the visiting side's survival hopes.
The day after clinching the Premier League title without kicking a ball, 맨체스터 유나이티드 defeat 블랙번 로버스 3–1 at Old Trafford.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 seal the Division One title and promotion to the Premier League with a 2–0 win at 그림즈비 타운. Their local rivals 미들즈브러 are relegated from the Premier League due to 셰필드 유나이티드's 2–0 win at 에버턴.
올덤 애슬레틱 remain in with a slim chance of Premier League survival by achieving a surprise 3–2 home win over 리버풀 at Boundary Park .

리버풀's 6–2 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼 sees them finish sixth. Oldham beat the drop in dramatic fashion with a 4–3 win over 사우샘프턴, while 크리스털 팰리스 go down in the last relegation place with a 3–0 defeat 아스널. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 seal promotion to the Premier League as Division One runners-up with a 2–0 home win over 케임브리지 유나이티드, who are relegated along with 브렌트퍼드 and 브리스틀 로버스, having been in the playoffs and on the brink of the Premier League just 12 months ago. 포츠머스 miss out on automatic promotion, and go into the playoffs along with 스윈던 타운, 레스터 시티 and 트랜미어 로버스. 밀월 lose 3–0 at home to 브리스틀 로버스 in Division One in their last game at The Den; they will move into a new 20,000-seat stadium at the start of next season. Halifax Town, who are bottom of Division Three after a disastrous second half of the season, are relegated from the Football League due to 노샘프턴 타운, the only team they could have caught, winning their final game of the season.

The last action of the season in Division One sees 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 레스터 시티 7–1 at home, with both Andy Cole and David Kelly scoring hat-tricks for the division's champions. Kelly is 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's top scorer with 25 league goals this season, while Cole has scored 12 times in as many games (including two hat-tricks) since his transfer from 브리스틀 시티. Meanwhile, some of the last Premier League games see QPR beat runners-up 애스턴 빌라 2–1 at Loftus Road, and champions 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 윔블던 2–1 at Selhurst Park in a game where 36-year-old captain Bryan Robson scores his first league goal in 18 months.
The first Premier League season draws to a close with 토트넘 홋스퍼 winning the North London derby 3–1 at Highbury, and QPR beating 셰필드 웬즈데이 by the same scoreline at Loftus Road.
레이턴 오리엔트 managing director Frank Clark , a former 노팅엄 포리스트 player, returns to the City Ground as the club's new manager.
Chris Waddle is voted FWA Footballer of the Year .

토트넘 홋스퍼 chairman Alan Sugar sacks chief executive and former team manager Terry Venables , who helped him take control of the club two years ago. However, Venables is reinstated within hours by a High Court injunction.
아스널 and 셰필드 웬즈데이 draw 1–1 in the FA Cup final . Ian Wright opens the scoring for the North Londoners in the 20th minute, but David Hirst equalises for Trevor Francis 's men after 61 minutes.
The inauguration match of J. League , Verdy Kawasaki vs 요코하마 F. 마리노스 is held at the National Stadium of Japan .
Six days after leaving 첼시, David Webb is named as the new manager of 브렌트퍼드, in place of Phil Holder after the West London club's relegation from Division One.
아스널 defeats 셰필드 웬즈데이 2–1 in the replay to claim the FA Cup .

아스널 beat 셰필드 웬즈데이 2–1 in the FA Cup final replay. Once again, Ian Wright opens the scoring, with a goal in the 34th minute. Chris Waddle equalises in the 68th minute, but with just one minute of extra time remaining, Andy Linighan wins the match with a goal for 아스널. Steve Coppell resigns after nine years manager of 크리스털 팰리스.

In France , start the " Affair OM-VA " corruption scandal by 마르세유 and Valenciennes . One week later, on 26 May, 마르세유's squad win the UEFA Champions League defeating AC 밀란 1–0 at the Olympiastadion in Munich. On 29 May, 마르세유 win the French league , but are stripped of the title by the French Football Federation on 22 September, with no winner assigned. In October/November the France national football team fail to qualify for the 1994 World Cup after losses to Israel and Bulgaria .
Keith Alexander becomes the first permanent black manager of an English league side when he is named as Steve Thompson 's successor at 링컨 시티 .
Copa Libertadores won by São Paulo FC after defeating Club Deportivo Universidad Católica on an aggregate score, 5–3.
Striker Nigel Clough agrees to join 리버풀 from 노팅엄 포리스트 in a £2.75 million deal.
위건 애슬레틱 announce Kenny Swain as their new manager following relegation to Division Three.

England draw 1–1 with Poland in Katowice , extending their unbeaten run in the World Cup qualifiers to seven games. 요크 시티 win the Division Three play-off final on penalties over 크루 알렉산드라 after a 1–1 draw.
웨스트브로미치 앨비언 win the Division Two play-off final and secure promotion to Division One with a 3–0 win over 포트 베일 . 셰필드 유나이티드 goalkeeper Mel Rees dies of cancer aged 26.
스윈던 타운 are promoted to the top division of English football after 73 years of trying thanks to a 4–3 win over 레스터 시티 in the Division One play-off final.
